Your teachers are drowning in workload. AI can buy back hours every week, if they know how to use it safely.

Practical AI training for schools and trusts, built around the realities of teaching: lesson planning, differentiation, marking, and parent communication. Safe, GDPR-aware, and grounded in classroom practice.

Book a 20-minute call Download the schools one-pager (PDF)

What your staff gain

Hours back every week

AI handles the first draft of lesson plans, differentiated resources, quizzes, and parent emails, so staff spend their time on the work only they can do.

Confidence, not anxiety

We start with the worry that sits underneath AI in every staffroom, and replace it with practical, repeatable skills.

Safe by default

Staff leave knowing exactly what is and is not safe to put into an AI tool, using a simple decision matrix they can apply in seconds.

Trust and safety

Schools are right to be cautious. Our training answers the hard questions before they’re asked.

Data and GDPR

We teach staff exactly what never goes into a public AI tool: no pupil names, no SEND data, no safeguarding details. Our Green/Amber/Red decision matrix makes the line unmissable.

Academic integrity

How to design AI-resistant assessment and recognise AI-generated work, rather than pretending pupils are not already using these tools.

Age-appropriate use

How staff can guide pupils to use AI safely, within your school's policy rather than around it.
